name: Electric Kick-Scooter
description: A stand-up scooter on two wheels in line, with a platform for standing, handlebar steering and an electric motor of no more than 500 W that gives it a top speed of 24 km/h, allowed on a municipality's roads only where its by-laws permit.

restrictions.rule: Allowed only under a provincial pilot project evaluating e-scooters
Two wheels on the same longitudinal axis, a standing platform between them, and a handlebar acting directly on the steered wheel
An electric motor of no more than 500 W with a top speed of 24 km/h, powered only by its batteries, that stops propelling it when the throttle is released or the brakes are applied
No seat, pedals or basket, wheels no more than 430 mm in diameter, and no more than 45 kg including the battery
Must not be modified to exceed its power or speed limits
Riders must be 16 or older and must stand; riders under 18 must wear a bicycle or motorcycle helmet
No passengers, no cargo, and no towing or being towed
Needs a bell or horn, and a white or amber front light and red rear light at night
Not a motor vehicle: no driver's licence, registration, plates or insurance, though municipal by-laws on motorized vehicles apply unless they say otherwise
Allowed on a municipality's roads, sidewalks, trails, paths or parks only where its by-laws permit; on the road it must use a bike lane where there is one, otherwise the shoulder or the right edge
Not allowed on the 400-series highways or the other controlled-access highways listed in Regulations 627 and 630, or on any highway closed to pedestrians or bicycles
